body.condition: For every conditioning operation actually used by a source factor or restriction transcript in a correctly typed run on \(E_0\), \(E\), or \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}\), the exact support table returned by \(\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}}(S)\) must give \(P_S\{H_{\mathrm{slice}}(S,\ell)\}>0\) whenever that operation conditions the acquired law of a legal protocol \(S\in\Pi\) on \(H_{\mathrm{slice}}(S,\ell)\), with no requirement on source cells unused by the run.

novel.justification: This event-local condition makes exactly the denominators used by operational certificates nonzero while permitting unused cells to have zero mass and supplying no semantic soundness or completeness theorem for CTFIDU+.
